goal.raw_text: Receive situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
The Link 16 network is operational and capable of exchanging surveillance information using fixed format messages.
C² JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages are transmitting surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
The Non-C2 JU receives a surveillance message (e.g., J3 series) or a status change message (e.g., J7.0 with ACT = 3 or 4) containing updated track data or alert indicators.

trigger.raw_text: The Non-C2 JU receives a surveillance message (e.g., J3 series) or a status change message (e.g., J7.0 with ACT = 3 or 4) containing updated track data or alert indicators.

claims.content: The Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
The received surveillance information may include Point surveillance data included in the J3.0 Reference Point message and the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
The received surveillance information may include Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.2 Air Track message and the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information may include Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
The received surveillance information may include Land (Ground) surveillance data included in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
The received surveillance information may include Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.
The received surveillance information may include Electronic Warfare surveillance data included in the J3.7 EW Product Information message.

If the received data includes Request Indicator Values for categories such as REFERENCE POINT, EA DATA, ES DATA, EW FIXES, WEAPON STATUS, AMPLIFICATION, or FILTER, the system processes the corresponding response messages (e.g., J3.0, J3.7, J14.2, J10.2, J13.3, J13.5, J6.0, J7.6).

The Non-C2 JU applies receive filters to delete data received on a data link prior to entry into an IU database if configured to prevent data link overload conditions, overload of a system database, and/or undesired data from entering a system database.
If the received data includes a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message, the Non-C2 JU shall clear the alert in its databases upon receipt.
Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J2.0 message with the EMG IND and/or FT IND set to value 0.
Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message initiating/terminating an alert on a PU/RU being forwarded onto Link 16, the FJU shall accept and report the condition in the J2.0 message.
Other receiving JUs shall initiate/terminate the alert in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.
A C² JU shall have the capability to initiate/terminate a force tell alert on another JU by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message, the JU whose force tell status is being changed shall accept and report the change in its J2 message.
The other JUs shall set/clear the alert indicator in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
Optionally, other JUs may clear the alert indicator upon reception of a J2 message with FT IND set to value 0.
If the received data includes Request Indicator Values for FILTER, the system processes the corresponding response message J7.6, which is transmitted to a specific address only.
If the received data includes Request Indicator Values for REFERENCE POINT, the system responds only with J3.0 lines and areas defined by more than one J3.0 message.

If the received data includes Request Indicator Values for EA DATA, ES DATA, or EW FIXES, the system responds only with existing EW ACTION VALUE = 7, 8, or 9 evaluations and associations concerning the applicable requested data type, which own JU has initiated if the request is collectively addressed, or locally held if the request is specifically addressed.
These J14.2 messages shall be addressed to the requesting unit, with R/C = 1.

If the received data includes a track that needs to be dropped due to operator error or simulation status change, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported.
The one exception to dropping a track via J7.0 (ACT = 0) is that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.
If the Non-C2 JU has the capability to purge remote tracks/points, it may automatically drop a remote track/point after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report.
The JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a purged remote track/point.
If a Non-C2 JU receives a J7.0 (ACT = 2) Change Data Order message containing an ID of Pending, it shall not accept that order.
Receiving JUs which do not implement the changed Environment/Category and have R² on the track must cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
The Non-C2 JU has accepted the alert in its databases.
The Non-C2 JU has cleared the alert in its databases if set, upon receipt of a J2 message with the EMG IND set to value 0.
The Non-C2 JU has set or cleared the alert indicator in its databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 4) message regarding force tell status changes.
Optionally, other JUs may clear the alert indicator upon reception of a J2 message with FT IND set to value 0.
